title: Construct the empirical law and evaluate its actual risk
source_anchor: Samplinglib original quadratic feature-risk supplement v1, interface3
target_statement: Let W be a measurable space with measurable singleton points, Omega a measurable data space and P any measure on Omega. Let N>0, w:Fin N->W, scalar features K:W->Omega->R, and a label y:Omega->R. Suppose K(w_j) and y are in L²(P). Define rho=N^{-1} sum_j Dirac(w_j), using reciprocal N as an ENNReal measure weight. Then rho is a probability measure, the actual loss (integral K(q,omega) drho(q)-y(omega))² is integrable under P, and its integral equals ||N^{-1} sum_j [K(w_j)]-[y]||². Particle values may coincide. No global measurability in q or probability assumption on P is required for this finite atomic assertion.
